ACT 1 OF 1991
ACT 1 OF 1991
SUPPRESSION OF TERRORIST (SPECIAL COURTS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Suppression of Terrorist Activities
(Special Courts) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 28th March, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President, on the 17th
March, 1991 and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Act may be called the
Suppression of Terrorist (Special Courts) (Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall !come into force at
once,

sections.description:
Amendment of Schedule, Act XV of 1975

ACT 1 OF 1991
ACT 1 OF 1991
SUPPRESSION OF TERRORIST (SPECIAL COURTS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the Suppression of Terrorist Activities
(Special Courts) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 28th March, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President, on the 17th
March, 1991 and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of Schedule, Act XV of 1975.--In the Suppression of
Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) Act, 1975, in the Schedule, in paragraph
(a) in sub-paragraph (i) after the figures letter and comma "124A,"
the figure, letter and comma "365A," shall be inserted and shall be
deemed to have been so inserted on the third day of September, 1989.
